「你要夠好，才值得被愛。」: "You have to be good enough to deserve love."
很多人從小就把這句話放進心裡，然後用一輩子去證明。: Many of us took this sentence in as children and spent our lives trying to prove it.
可是被愛從來不是考試。你不用先變得更好、更有用、更完美，才有資格被好好對待。: But being loved was never a test. You don't have to become better, more useful or more perfect before you deserve to be treated well.
你不需要證明什麼。: You don't have anything to prove.
今天對自己說一句，平常只會對好朋友說的話。: Today, say one thing to yourself that you'd usually only say to a good friend.
